description: This file defines a report for income tax deductions in the ERPNext system, including functions to generate report columns, filter conditions, and retrieve data related to employee income tax components, specifically tailored for the Indian region.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, returning columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates the list of columns for the report, including conditional columns based on region.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and processes salary and deduction data for employees, tailored for Indian region.
